steps.speaker: Female News Anchor
steps.content: Since N.F. 112, after humanity's initial triumph in containing BR-004, the 23-year-long BR-001, and the recurring BR-002 have also been successfully suppressed. Humanity has finally established viable protocols to address extreme Mania incidents.

steps.speaker: Female News Anchor
steps.content: The following year, DisCity finally found respite from the Black Ring crisis, ushering in a long-awaited era of peace and prosperity. At last, it might be time for humanity to dispel this prolonged darkness.

steps.speaker: Female News Anchor
steps.content: With these aspirations for the future, DisCity will soon witness the most significant political event in the lives of its citizens—

steps.speaker: Female News Anchor
steps.content:
<size=75>The 22nd <color=#fb9259>DisCity Election</color>
Coming on <color=#fb9259>December 26, N.F. 114</color></size>

November 27, N.F. 114
MBCC
Chief's Office

Malcolm Enoch, Vice President, Nirvana Regarding West District Development Dear Chief, the development of the West District is a matter of our mutual interest. I look forward to meeting with you to delve into its future growth. Jonathan Moy, Bureau of Energy and Industry Meeting Invitation from the Jacknal Family Dear Chief, I am honored to invite you to a meeting on behalf of the Jacknal family. This presents a remarkable opportunity, as you are well aware of their influence in Eastside. Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 27th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! Howdy, Chief! I am Max King, the primary candidate in this election. I have always held your reputation in high regard and would like to extend my heartfelt greetings and deep respect to you! Nightingale, MBCC Adjutant MBCC December Meeting Schedule Chief, we have received numerous meeting requests leading up to the election. I have tentatively organized the schedule, with pending requests attached to this email. Kindly review the Upcoming Visitor Request List.

Malcolm Enoch, Vice President, Nirvana Regarding West District Development Dear Chief, urgent attention is needed for the development of the West District. Kindly schedule a meeting at your earliest convenience to explore potential solutions. Jonathan Moy, Bureau of Energy and Industry Meeting Invitation from the Jacknal Family Dear Chief, Mr. Jacknal seems displeased by the absence of your response. A prompt reply from you would be greatly appreciated. Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 28th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! Howdy, Chief! I am Max King, the leading candidate in this election. I am eagerly anticipating having a discussion with you!

Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 29th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! Howdy, Chief! I have been closely following your remarkable career, and your achievements never fail to impress me! It's striking how our views align on matters concerning the West District, FAC, and even Paradeisos. We could...
Click! You shut the mail browser and rub your strained eyes—that last email not only employed ridiculously large font but also came with several photos of yourself attached.

Even with the strictest filter settings in place, these spam-like promotional mails still have managed to find their way into your work inbox... which means they must all be coming through official whitelist channels and legitimate special access.
What an Election this has been—seeing all these big shots humble themselves and practically shove their olive branches in the face of a nobody like you.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: As expected. During the election, every party will do whatever it takes to win support. At the very least, they don't want to see someone of your influence side with their opponents.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What kind of influence am I supposed to have?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm just an administrator of a secret agency, without much authority or resources. Plus, topics like Mania and Sinners aren't exactly crowd-pleasers around here.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: You're being far too modest. Let me show you something interesting.
The person on the other end of the call moves away from the frame, followed by some rustling sounds as she searches for something.

That is <color=#fb9259>Matilda Cavendish</color>. Though born into an established Eastside family, she has always empathized with the struggling Syndicate underclass. During the BR-002 operation in N.F. 113, she fought alongside you.

Afterwards, she registered as a Sinner at the MBCC and returned to Syndicate. She has helped reform the West District Reconstruction Committee, develop the new mine, and actively advocate for Syndican rights, all the while maintaining friendly contact with you.
—That is, when you both have the luxury of time.
—Which rarely happens.
Still, these moments are precious whenever they come.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Found it.
A newspaper sheet featuring your photo emerges in the frame. The headline reads: "Black Ring Vanquisher! Hero of the West District! Vote for Chief of Minos!! Voice for Freedom and Justice!!!"

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cough cough cough!!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What the—what is that??

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: A precious shot taken by Mr. Donald. Raven wasn't happy with the original copy and made a few tweaks. The plan is to produce hundreds of copies and have the Homeless spearhead a local promotion.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: We heard you're coming back to join the election on behalf of the West District.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is way too ridiculous. Are they really pulling this kind of prank?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: It's been a long time, Chief. Everyone's missing you dearly.
Everyone must be feeling swamped lately, especially with such a crucial state-wide election on the horizon.

Every four years, the citizens of DisCity elect their <color=#fb9259>Prime Minister of the City Council</color>, a prestigious Speaker that serves as the chief executive and unifying voice of all parties. This direct election allows every eligible citizen to cast their vote for one of the designated candidates, choosing who will guide their future.
For the people of the West District, who only regained their DisCitizenship last year, this election was supposed to be a pivotal chance to fight for their rights.

However, concerns linger about whether the "designated candidates" truly represent the interests of the West District. Moreover, the Syndicans face significant hurdles in merely securing their <color=#fb9259>right to vote</color>. Pondering the complexities, you look down at the documents in your hands...

DisCity Prime Minister Election Voter Eligibility Requirements 1. Eligibility is granted to any resident aged 18 or above, who has maintained continuous residence in DisCity for over five years and possesses DisCitizenship. 2. Active FAC members will have their voting rights temporarily suspended for the duration of their service. These rights will be reinstated upon completion of service and formal discharge from active duty.

N.F. 114 Special Act: Supplementary Provisions on Voter Eligibility To further clarify the definition of DisCity's jurisdiction regarding the residency period criterion for voter eligibility, this Act establishes the following supplementary rules for calculating residency periods in specific regions: For regions recently included within DisCity's jurisdiction, residents' duration of residency shall be calculated starting from the official date on which the region comes under City Council administration. For regions that were once temporarily separated from council administration, residents' duration of residency shall be calculated starting from the date of reintegration into administration. This Act shall take effect immediately upon passage, and voter eligibility for the election shall be verified and adjusted in accordance with these new provisions.

Shameless are these "supplementary provisions." It hasn't been six months since the West District's reintegration, yet the Eastside councilors have rushed through these regulations to block the Syndicans from participating in the election, all to repress their voice for integration and afford Eastside powers more time to tighten their grip on the West District.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I heard they pressured you during negotiations, demanding the West District pay five years' worth of administrative costs if you want to shorten the verification period? Just the nerve of these people.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Donald has been bombarded with lawsuits from Nirvana as well. At this rate, it seems like the West District might be years away from having its own representative.
You feel a surge of indignation, yet Matilda, who's been with the Executive Committee on the frontlines of negotiations the whole time, remains perfectly composed.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Just some desperate moves from the opponent. Stewart's crushed his reputation by stomping on the West District these years. He stands no chance at re-election, and once he's out, all these radical policies will be scraps of paper.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: And even without any say in the matter, the West District's now sitting on a mine, literally. That's leverage we can use against those politicians. The Syndicans have moved past martial arts—now it's all about the verbal art of negotiation.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Think about it—just last year, the Syndicans weren't even recognized as DisCitizens. Now, they're back and making heads turn.
Matilda's casual tone suggests tangible progress in their work, making you—someone who only occasionally drops by—seem almost overly concerned.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: How are things on your end, Chief?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I heard that the Underground Mania network has been taken down. Things have been pretty quiet these days, right? And you've been running out of town for missions lately?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Can't afford to lower my guard.

steps.content: I just can't shake this feeling that if I let my guard down, all those dreadfulness—the Black Rings, the Mania outbreaks, the riots—will come flooding back to haunt me.
She offers a knowing smile, her expression showing she had expected exactly that answer.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: You've brought peace to the city. Once the new mine is up and running, it will surely bring us a better future. This election's bound to bring changes to many of us.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Chief, a new era is dawning—one of stability and progress. We'll all be part of it, and that includes you too.
Even someone as composed as Matilda can't hide the excitement in her voice. The future she envisions must truly be something to look forward to.
Which makes it even harder for you to bring yourself to mention those things lurking in the shadows—the real reasons why you can't find peace of mind.

Throughout the DisMyth elimination operation, significant evidence emerged indicating that the Underground Mania forces had extensively interfered with the N.F. 110 Election, orchestrating numerous instances of assassination, bribery, forgery, and false accusations.

That operation concluded with the successful destruction of the DisMyth network servers. The network's lead developer, the genius programmer serving the Underground, <color=#fb9259>Moore</color>, was declared dead when her shackle connection went dark.

Following that, the 9th Agency initiated a covert investigation into the current Prime Minister and his cabinet, thoroughly probing for possible collusion with the Underground forces while maintaining constant surveillance.
But you know that this isn't the end.
All those mysteries involving that woman, her power, and her hidden motive—is she really dead? Was she truly the sole participant from those unfathomable Underground forces?
Moreover, if those people interfered with the election four years ago, there is no reason to believe they wouldn't attempt something similar now.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Chief?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Sorry, I got carried away.
However, these burdens are not to be shared with a friend—she should focus on her own work, the promising picture of the West District.
All the dark premonitions are yours to shoulder alone, with your gaze fixed on the shadows, upholding eternal vigilance.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let's work together for a better future.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I, too, am looking forward to this bright new era.
Just as those words escape your lips, the emergency line cuts in with several beeps, interrupting your call with Matilda.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, sorry to interrupt, but there's an emergency that needs your attention.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Something happened, Chief.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Can't say for sure; it's not something we're used to seeing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm on my way.
Well, that marks the end of your break.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: An emergency, right? Go ahead, Chief. I'm sure everything will work out with you in charge.
After several confrontations with the Underground, you deem yourself prepared for whatever may come.
However, five minutes later, events unfold in a way that surpasses even your darkest expectations.

steps.speaker: Female News Anchor
steps.content: Breaking news: Yesterday at 11:58 PM, an explosion rocked the city hall at Building 17, 105th Street, District 3 of Eastside. The blast has resulted in the loss of 26 lives, with 3 individuals currently in critical condition.

steps.speaker: Female News Anchor
steps.content: After <color=#fb9259>Prime Minister Stewart</color> was urgently transported to Eastside Central Hospital, he was pronounced dead at 4:23 AM despite all medical efforts.

steps.speaker: Female News Anchor
steps.content: A one-kilometer perimeter around the site has been cordoned off as multiple government departments launch a joint investigation. Currently, no details have been disclosed to the public. As District 3 has been declared under a state of emergency, Benjamin Carter, Head of the Health Committee, has announced his interim appointment at the council. He will be responsible for overseeing government operations until the Election.

steps.speaker: Female News Anchor
steps.content: Notably, Carter stands eleventh in the line of succession, while all ten senior cabinet officials preceding him <color=#fb9259>fell victim to the explosion</color>.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: The explosion is merely a cover story. Given the approaching election, it's the only viable narrative we can present. It is now up to us to uncover the truth swiftly and discreetly.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Chief, the 9th Agency and FAC are both in position waiting for you. Let's see what kind of present our little friends from the Underground have left us.

<size=55>This marks the true beginning of the N.F. 114 Eastside Election.
A new era thus announces its dawn.
HERE is where it all starts.</size>
